description: This file contains an implementation of the DeleteFeatureLiveCommand for the 'live' modify commands in the Eclipse Ditto project. It defines the DeleteFeatureLiveCommandImpl class, which is an immutable class handling delete feature commands and extending abstract modify live command functionality.

classes.name: DeleteFeatureLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: An immutable implementation of DeleteFeatureLiveCommand used for live modify delete feature commands.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DeleteFeatureLiveCommandImpl from a generic Command object, casting it to DeleteFeature.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the feature ID associated with this delete command.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of DeleteFeatureLiveCommandImpl with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether the command changes authorization; returns false in this implementation.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Creates and returns a new answer builder for this command.
